topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 106 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 30 common project-authored base contract(s) (reentrancyguarddeprecated, reentrancyguardtransient, pauseable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
